Hi Alex —

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd like to set up a 60-minute technical walkthrough with Solutions Engineering and any customer engineers/procurement folks you'd like to include. Goal: show an end-to-end inference flow, discuss security and data handling, and capture procurement questions so we can get a SOW draft started.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Nov 10, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Nov 10, 14:00–15:00
- Wed Nov 11, 09:00–10:00

If none of these work, please propose 2 alternatives and include any colleagues who need to join (security/procurement/infra). Attached is a short agenda and a 1-page checklist to help your procurement team.

Agenda (attached): 1) architecture walkthrough 2) performance profile & pricing levers 3) security/compliance summary 4) next steps (SOW & timeline)

Thanks — happy to be flexible on length if you need additional time for procurement.

Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks, that looks great. I'm looping in Maya from procurement and our lead infra engineer (I'll forward their calendar availability once I have it). Quick notes from my side:

- Procurement will want a short readout on data residency and retention before the call — Maya, can you confirm which docs you need?

From our side, tentative availability:
- Tue Nov 10, 09:30–10:30 (tight)
- Wed Nov 11, 09:00–10:00

Thanks Alex — and welcome Maya.

Maya — quick intro: I'm Chloe, the AE on this opportunity. Attached is the agenda I sent; we can surface data-residency and retention notes in the first 10 minutes. For procurement, a short SOC2 / data flow summary usually covers most questions — I'll ask Aditya to include the compliance slide and a pointer to our evidence bundle.

Aditya / Ben — are you able to join Wed Nov 11 at 09:00 PT? If so I'll lock that and send the calendar invite. If the infra engineer needs a separate pre-call (15–20m) before the demo, say so and we can schedule.

If we confirm Wed I'll also drop a pre-read packet (SOC2 highlights + sample SOW) — want to get procurement the right artifacts ahead of time.

Chloe

Chloe / team —

Thanks for the heads-up. I'm available Wed Nov 11 at 09:00 PT for the main walkthrough. Ben will join as the lead SE for architecture + latency tuning.

Two small asks so we make the session productive:
1) Can the infra engineer share a one-paragraph note about their current infra (cloud provider, expected qps, whether they need private deployment/VPC)? That helps us tailor the demo.
2) If procurement wants SOC2 artifacts, we can provide a redacted evidence bundle — I'll attach a small index now and drop the secure link after Chloe pins the attendee list.

Also: if you prefer a 75-minute slot (45m demo + 30m procurement + Q/A), we can reserve that. Otherwise 60m is fine if procurement agrees to a follow-up.

Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
